# B. Morvay Coaching

> Online strength and nutrition coaching for busy professionals, by Balazs Morvay, a personal trainer and sports massage therapist based in Edinburgh, Scotland. BSc (Hons) Physical Activity and Health, 10+ years in the industry. Coaching is £200 a month with no minimum term. In-person training and mobile sports massage are available in Edinburgh and nearby.

Key facts:
- Coaching, £200 a month, paid monthly in advance, no minimum term: a personal training plan built around goals, equipment and schedule; a nutrition plan with daily calorie and protein targets (not meal plans); a check-in after the first week and then every two weeks, with a video or phone call when it helps; messages on WhatsApp or iMessage answered within two working days (Monday to Friday); feedback on videos of your lifts, up to 2 a week; a review at the end of each training block and the next block built from it; home gym planning.
- Programme Block, £100 one-off: a personal 4 to 12 week training plan with daily calorie and protein targets (not meal plans), to follow on your own, with one round of changes within 14 days. No check-ins or messaging. Food targets are not included for clients who take an appetite-lowering medicine or have a history of disordered eating; for them food targets come with coaching.
- In-person sessions in Edinburgh and nearby: £50 at a private garage gym, or £60 at the client's home gym or a gym that allows visiting trainers. Open to anyone; monthly coaching is not required.
- Mobile sports massage, £50 for 45 minutes, in Edinburgh and nearby, subject to availability.
- Home gym planning: equipment and layout advice only, no building work. Included with coaching, or quoted by scope.
- Sign-up order: a free call, then a written agreement and payment, then a private health questionnaire. A full refund if the health answers mean coaching cannot start.
- Enquiries are answered within one working day. The first call is free and takes 30 minutes.
- Full refund if a coaching client is not happy within their first 14 days, or if a Programme Block client is not happy within 14 days of getting their plan. Cancel coaching any time before the next payment date, with no fee.
- Coaching is for adults aged 18 or over. People taking GLP-1 weight-loss medicines are welcome; the prescribing clinician stays in charge of the medicine.
- Location: Edinburgh, Scotland for in-person services; online coaching wherever the client trains. Google Business Profile: https://share.google/cJ5u14vFF04bbxpgY
- Contact: morvaybalazs@gmail.com, +44 7914 390913
